title: justicia graciliflora
intro: Justicia graciliflora, commonly known as "Queen's Wears Crown", is a plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Justicia graciliflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, analgesic, and anti-diarrheal effects. The plant is used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, and has also been studied for its potential in treating more serious conditions, such as cancer and HIV.
